offers_products.reason: Makes radiation detection instruments, spectroscopy systems, germanium detectors, dosimeters, and radiotherapy QA software (Sun Nuclear).

offers_services.reason: Dosimetry services (badge monitoring), Certrec licensing/compliance consulting, Paragon engineering services alongside instruments.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are nuclear plants, hospitals, labs, defense and industry; no household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to nuclear utilities, hospitals and cancer centers, research labs, defense and government agencies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Majority is equipment and system sales and projects; recurring dosimetry and service revenue is a smaller part.

cyclical_demand.reason: Nuclear plant safety, regulatory compliance and cancer care radiation QA are mandated and non-discretionary, so spending is resilient.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly instruments, detectors, dosimeters and software at moderate prices, bought frequently; some large plant systems.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is mainly from manufactured detection instruments and software, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are nuclear utilities, defense, government agencies and large hospital systems.

asset_heavy.reason: Instrument manufacturing and software need moderate plants; not heavy fleets or networks.

notes: Recurring share is uncertain; judged from product-led mix.
